sources.title: Land contamination: technical guidance
sources.facts: Last updated 13 May 2026; collection covers risk-based approaches, planning, Part 2A, site-condition reports, groundwater and human-health risks.
sources.guard: Collection coverage does not prove a parcel is contaminated, remediated, suitable or compliant.

sources.title: Land affected by contamination
sources.facts: Explains planning's role, pollutant linkages, desk study, site investigation, remediation and interaction with other regimes.
sources.guard: Generic risk framework does not replace parcel-specific investigation, laboratory evidence, conceptual model or regulator decision.

sources.title: Land stability
sources.role: Planning Practice Guidance on unstable land
sources.facts: Covers landslide, subsidence and ground-heave risks and the planning role in establishing suitability.
sources.guard: Guidance does not prove ground condition, engineering feasibility, insurance status or structural safety at a specific site.

sources.title: Waste: environmental permits
sources.role: Current waste permit route and permit-type guidance
sources.facts: Last updated 12 February 2026; distinguishes regulatory position statements, exemptions, standard-rules and bespoke permits.
sources.guard: Permit-route guidance does not prove a site holds a valid permit, exemption registration, planning permission or compliant operations.

sources.title: Check if you need an environmental permit
sources.facts: Last updated 2 March 2026; covers activities that may pollute or affect flood risk, drainage or water resources.
sources.guard: Screening guidance is not a regulator determination and does not establish that an activity is exempt or authorised.

sources.title: Apply for an environmental permit
sources.facts: Published 12 February and updated 26 February 2026; explains online application, advice, costs and post-grant steps.
sources.guard: Application availability or submission does not prove grant, conditions, planning consent, commencement or compliance.

sources.title: How you'll be regulated: environmental permits
sources.role: Permit compliance, inspection and review guidance
sources.facts: Explains compliance assessments, inspections, permit reviews, operator competence and possible revocation.
sources.guard: Regulatory process guidance does not prove current compliance, inspection result, operator competence or permit continuity.

sources.title: Landfill operators: environmental permits - Plan the environmental setting of your site
sources.role: Landfill location, risk-assessment and permit guidance
sources.facts: Explains that waste planning authority location decisions and Environment Agency bespoke permits are separate requirements.
sources.guard: A planning allocation, permit application or environmental-setting assessment does not prove location approval, permit grant or acceptable residual risk.
